decisions.name: Character-specific voice
decisions.audit_reason: Assesses distinctive, controlled character voice versus generic or gimmicky voice -- craft evaluation.

decisions.name: Form mirrors content
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards form that enacts the story's idea over generic default narration -- formal craft judgment.

sign_contradiction_reaudit.reason: The low anchor penalizes any generic past-tense narration, so what a judge actually counts is presence of formal marking (verse, lists, odd punctuation, person/tense), a stylistic habit.

decisions.name: Beats escalate; the situation becomes irreversible
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether stakes escalate irreversibly versus stalling or repeating -- plot-craft evaluation.

decisions.name: Fresh handling of a familiar trope
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards subverting or complicating genre convention -- an originality/craft judgment about the writing.

decisions.name: Resonant closing image
decisions.audit_reason: Assesses whether the ending crystallizes meaning versus being generic or abrupt -- craft evaluation.

decisions.name: Subtextual Character Conflict
decisions.audit_reason: Distinguishes implied, embodied motive from flatly announced motive -- classic characterization craft.

decisions.name: Self-Contained Narrative Payoff
decisions.audit_reason: Evaluates whether the piece completes a meaningful, earned arc -- structural narrative-quality judgment.

decisions.name: Sentence-level freshness vs. cliche phrasing
decisions.audit_reason: Distinguishes fresh, apt phrasing from cliche stock diction -- direct sentence-craft evaluation.

decisions.name: Moral discomfort left standing, not resolved for the reader
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards moral ambiguity left unresolved over pat lesson-delivery -- literary sophistication judgment.

sign_contradiction_reaudit.reason: Refusal to editorialize, coherent-and-wrong narrators, unresolved endings are real editorial virtues; anchors are concrete and shock content explicitly excluded. Negative sign reflects community preference for cathartic resolution.

decisions.name: Selective Sensory Specificity
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards selective, functional sensory detail over generic ornamentation -- a prose-craft judgment.

decisions.name: Earned recontextualization
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether a twist is prepared by earlier evidence versus merely appended -- craft evaluation.

decisions.name: Agency under constraint
decisions.audit_reason: Measures whether protagonist choices reveal character and carry costs -- core craft evidence of story quality.

decisions.name: Dramatized Exposition
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards context delivered through action/dialogue over inert explanatory passages -- structural craft.

decisions.name: Premise-to-Plot Transformation
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether a premise generates real conflict and meaning versus decorative mention -- craft judgment.

decisions.name: Narrative economy
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether prose serves character/tension/theme versus boilerplate padding -- a craft judgment.

decisions.name: Text is community apparatus rather than narrative
decisions.audit_reason: Detects subreddit/moderation machinery displacing fiction -- platform apparatus, not a quality judgment.

decisions.name: External-audience promotion
decisions.audit_reason: Counts links, plugs, and feedback requests -- promotional platform furniture, not the story itself.

decisions.name: Explicit novice disclaimer or feedback solicitation
decisions.audit_reason: Flags author's meta-commentary about experience or feedback requests -- not a property of the story.

decisions.name: Dialogue-first openings
decisions.audit_reason: Estimates share of dialogue at story open, a purely structural/stylistic fingerprint with no quality judgment.

decisions.name: Serial continuity cues
decisions.audit_reason: Counts references to prior/future installments -- a serial-format/platform marker, not story merit.

decisions.name: Editorial polish signature
decisions.audit_reason: Measures mechanical spelling/formatting consistency, closer to a proofreading/authorship fingerprint than narrative craft.

decisions.name: Borrowed famous characters and pre-existing fictional worlds
decisions.audit_reason: Measures reliance on borrowed IP/fandom material, a content-provenance fingerprint, not execution quality.

decisions.name: Explicit tournament/contest round or heat marker
decisions.audit_reason: Detects explicit round/heat/bracket contest language -- platform contest formatting, not story merit.

decisions.name: Dialogue punctuation mark count
decisions.audit_reason: Counts quotation marks only; instruction explicitly ignores whether dialogue is well written.

decisions.name: Final-paragraph word count
decisions.audit_reason: Pure word-count of last paragraph; instruction explicitly ignores content or whether the ending lands.

note: FREEZE sign-contradiction trigger: 2 A criteria had FIT+MINE alone-AUC < .5; a fresh sealed re-auditor re-read their instructions and re-routed 1 of them to the nuisance side.
